release_wait_model.scope: Version tag push to verified release draft. Human publication time is excluded.

projection.baseline_formula: 258 second checks + max(260 second x64, 289 second ARM64) + 39 second historical overhead
assumptions: Both Windows architectures use the candidate and receive the stated benefit.
ARM64 has not been measured with ThinLTO 16. Its benefit is an assumption.
The 26 percent sample contains GUI, CLI and a synthetic example. The release workflow has no such example.
The measured check, build and historical overhead come from different runs and commits.
Other jobs, queue time, package upload time and draft creation do not become the slowest path.
Caches are warm. First adoption and cache misses have different costs.
